scripts.dev: docker-compose up -d postgres && (docker-compose up -d pgadmin || true) && bun run --filter './packages/*' build && bun run --filter './apps/*' dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter './packages/*' build && bun run --filter './apps/*' build
scripts.ci: (docker-compose up -d postgres || docker start plotarr-postgres || true) && bun run format && bun run lint && bun run build && bun run check-types && bun run test
scripts.clean: pkill -f 'esbuild' || true && killall -9 node || true && rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules /tmp/esbuild* && bun install
scripts.ls:
node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); console.log('
📋 Available Scripts:
'); Object.entries(pkg.scripts).forEach(([name, cmd]) => console.log('  ' + name.padEnd(25) + ' ' + cmd)); console.log('
💡 Usage: bun run <script-name>
');"
